title: Not the best 4 Hamilton Beach but okay for smoothies.
text: Not the best 4 Hamilton Beach but okay for smoothies.. Hamilton Beach like many other brands isn't that great anymore. This is a fairly cheaply made product. The blades aren't real sharp so I wouldn't use ice in it unless they are pre crushed. It's not super powerful but just good for smoothies mostly so you don't need much power. It's easy to use just a push of the button but don't lay on the button or it will overheat. It's easy to clean just be careful of the blade they're not real sure but yeah they're sharp.

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach Portable Blender for Shakes and Smoothies with 14 Oz BPA Free Travel Cup and Lid, Durable Stainless Steel Blades for Powerful Blending Performance, 2 Jars - White (51102V)
features: BLEND AND GO: Blend fruit smoothies, shakes and your favorite icy drinks right in the 14 oz. BPA-free travel jar. The personal blender jar comes with a travel lid to double as a to-go cup. It's lightweight and fits most car cup holders.

POWERFUL BLENDING PERFORMANCE: Durable stainless steel blades on the portable blender power through ice, frozen fruits and leafy greens for smooth results. Perfect for adding more vitamins and nutrients into your diet in smoothies and protein shakes.
QUICK & EASY CLEANUP: The blending jars, blades and travel lids on this Hamilton Beach blender are all dishwasher safe so cleaning up is a breeze.
COMPACT DESIGN FITS MOST CUP HOLDERS: The small size of the personal blender jar makes it perfect for the home, office, travel, small dorms and apartments. The compact base comes with a 24” cord.
EASY ONE-TOUCH BLENDING. Quickly prepare a variety of icy drinks by just pressing the button. It's so easy. This is sure to be your go-to blender for protein shakes and smoothies.
description: The Hamilton Beach Smoothie Blender with 2 travel Jars and 2 lids makes perfect smoothies and icy drinks thanks to its ice-crushing power. The portable design lets you blend and go because both jars function as travel mugs with sippable lids.
